expected_source: the printed value comes from building the identical C source with an independent host C compiler (cc -std=c99, identical at -O0 and -O2); there the shim holds every 40-bit value in an int64_t truncated back to 40 bits after each operation, so the host exercises the same arithmetic without the register pairs; the RTS exit path ends in abort(), which takes no argument, so only the CIO text is checked. The LSSUB corner where the subtrahend is exactly INT40_MIN is excluded: TI's compiled form (saturating NEG then SADD) differs from plain C semantics there by one ulp regardless of emulator behaviour
